answer: A ridge valley stays honest when every new identity must train a distinct falcon at a distinct ridge eyrie and fly it across the lagoon, while a distinct falconer logs each flight at the far shore. The first fake owes one flight log, the second five, the third fourteen, since the nth fake owes the sum of the squares up to n, so the tenth fake alone owes 385 logs and twenty fakes owe 2,870. Bulk farming fails because one falconer trains one falcon at a time and each bird flies one ridge crossing only, like one falconer flying a single falcon over one lagoon per dawn.
